R7AE-bear-backcountry-0001.name: 2.3 km SE of Gillis Creek

R7AE-bear-backcountry-0001.parkWhat: pull off on Thutade-Nation FSR (gravel road)

evidence.t: Cutblock harvested 2019 (7 years old), 170 m E: cutblocks and logging road edges green up first in spring (65%) and grow berries for the fall feed (lesson: Black bear).
Burn from 2021 (fire G61132), right here: burned areas are spring bear food (90%) and huckleberry grows in old burns (80%) (lessons: Black bear Masterclass 5, Habitat tour).
W facing slope, 11 degrees: grassy south facing slopes are spring bear food (90%, lesson: Black bear Masterclass 5).
Unnamed wetland 130 m SW: stream sides and skunk cabbage swamps are spring food, and bears forage on berries and spawning fish in fall (90%, lesson: Black bear Masterclass 5).
1 km or more from pavement and 2 km from a town: bears near people feed more at night (75%, lesson: Black bear Masterclass 6).

flags.t: Spot is inside an ATV (all terrain vehicle) for Hunting Closed Area: Omineca South and Central. Closed between 4:30 a.m. and 8:00 a.m. from August 15 to August 31, between 5:30 a.m. and 9:00 a.m. from September 1 to September 30 and between 6:30 a.m. and 10:00 a.m. from October 1 to November 15. Synopsis map 7-3/24.

plan: Drive: from District of Mackenzie, about 116 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 55.41196, -124.56045, pull off on Thutade-Nation FSR (gravel road). Map links below.
Walk: 5.4 km NE, cross country, no trail mapped. Climb about 166 m, about 124 min at 3 km/h.
Camp: flat ground 140 m NW of the spot at 1,207 m (55.45367, -124.51746). Water: unnamed wetland 160 m SW (estimate).

Hunt: black bear, Apr, May, June, Aug, Sept, Oct, Nov (season rows). Glass berry slopes, cutblocks and road edges at dawn and the last 2 hours of light, wind in your face (Tip). A bear under 2 years old and any bear with it are closed (99%, synopsis page 11).
Use: your .308 Winchester with a 150 to 180 grain expanding bullet (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 7-28, Region 7A. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-10-04, closures 2026-10-16.
R7AE-bear-backcountry-0001.popWhy: Less popular (quieter): MU 7-28: about 589 hunter days a year for black bear (2020 to 2024 mean), 0.08 days per square km, middle third of BC MUs; access: more than 5 km from a drivable road. Estimate, about 50% sure (my pick).
